context.target_user: Marketing managers and local business operators coordinating multi-author content
context.problem: Establishing standardized content briefs and structural hand-offs between business owners and content writers.
context.use_case: Constructing modular briefs with search intent taxonomy, heading hierarchy, and editorial checklists.

rationale: In Benchmark Test 04, Content Harmony standardized a 6-section brief with target word counts and intent cards, incorporating custom business facts. Conditioned on editorial review to prune generic national medical advice.
when_to_consider: When managing editorial hand-offs between business stakeholders and writers.
When standardizing content requirements across multiple service pages or locations.
when_not_to_use: For solo practitioners with very low content volume where credit-based subscriptions are not cost-effective.
